notes: The laptop finder now does any part, not just screens and batteries. A 'Part' dropdown lets you pick what you need — charge port / DC jack, keyboard, palmrest, hinges, lid/back cover, bezel, bottom case, fan/heatsink, trackpad, speakers, webcam, Wi-Fi card, charger/PSU, SSD, RAM, or 'other' — and each one carries the bench gotchas that matter for it. The charge port, for instance, tells you to work out whether it's soldered (a board-repair job), a modular daughterboard, or a USB-C board before you order. It searches your suppliers by the laptop model + the right keyword so you get the actual part, not accessories, and 'Find for THIS PC' works for every part type. Screens and batteries keep their exact part-number matching, price compare and history; the other parts are searched live and logged to your history too (so you'll see things like 'charge port for this model — searched 5 times').
